name: Hemalapuri Sadan
description: Official temple-managed guest house located close to the main complex. Rooms can be booked by directly contacting the management desk at +91 79899 93291.

name: Varahi Hotel
description: Located on Temple Road, a 1 to 2-minute walk from the temple. Standard budget rooms.

name: Param Residency
description: Located 280 to 400 metres away, situated behind the Alampur police station.

name: BRS Grand Luxury Lodge
description: Newer lodge offering AC and non-AC rooms located 1.04 km from the temple.

name: Haritha Hotel Alampur
description: Run by the Telangana State Tourism Development Corporation (TSTDC). Features standardized AC/non-AC rooms and an in-house restaurant.

name: Padma Hotel & Lodge
description: South Indian / local meals, budget tiffins, and lodging.
